تسرون (form I)
# تَسُرُّونَ (tasurrūna) /ta.sur.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of سَرَّ (sarra)
# تُسَرُّونَ (tusarrūna) /tu.sar.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of سَرَّ (sarra) and سُرَّ (surra)
# تَسَرُّونَ (tasarrūna) /ta.sar.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of سَرَّ (sarra)
